name: Prince Waikiki
insider_take: This oceanfront gem sits on the only private marina in Waikiki, offering unparalleled harbor views and direct yacht access in the heart of paradise.
whats_special: Prince Waikiki is the sole hotel with its own private marina, featuring 100 guest rooms with stunning Ala Wai Yacht Harbor views. The property's unique location on a peninsula provides panoramic ocean vistas from nearly every angle, while its award-winning Hinana Spa offers traditional Hawaiian healing treatments using indigenous plants and volcanic stones.
pro_tip: Book a harbor-view room on floors 25+ for breathtaking sunset views over the yacht marina – it's one of Waikiki's best-kept photo spots that most tourists never see.
dont_miss: The hotel's signature Keeaumoku Street entrance leads directly to the Ala Moana Shopping Center, while the rooftop pool deck offers 360-degree views of Diamond Head, downtown Honolulu, and the Pacific Ocean. The nearby Keeaumoku Marketplace features authentic local eateries beloved by Honolulu residents.
pros: Prime Waikiki Beach location with stunning ocean views
Modern rooms with floor-to-ceiling windows and private balconies
Multiple dining options including award-winning restaurants
Full-service spa and fitness center with harbor views
cons: Busy tourist area with high foot traffic
